stance_rationale: Core alpha statistics are positive, but the package relies on full 2004-2026 selection despite the 2024-01-23 sealed Lockbox, reinterprets failed cost/turnover evidence as incremental-only, and lacks required challenge/risk/optimizer artifacts. These are process-hard failures, not alpha-layer polish issues.

harvey_t.note: Overall NW-t passes, but search-space deflation is undercounted.

dsr.note: Reported value is DSR_z, not the required DSR ratio >= 0.50.

time_series_alpha_audit.comment: stage_artifacts/WT_D20260512_003/alpha_scores_new.parquet has 79,835 rows and monthly Date x Ticker scores, but the canonical requested qepm/stage_artifacts/WT_WT-D20260512_003/alpha_scores.parquet is missing and the emitted file includes Ret_1m labels beside scores.

pit_c1_c15_audit.evidence: Selection, grid search, diagnostics, and package claims use 2004-01 through 2026-04 without a Train-only selection and sealed Lockbox split.
alpha_scores_new.parquet carries Ret_1m in the same artifact as scores, creating downstream circular-use risk.
R05 is loaded through load_month_factors() as Z_Score_Aligned; no NEGATE_FACTORS or FLIP_SIGN pattern was found in WT scripts.
factor_db_connector.R enforces Usable_Date <= sig_date for IC-based direction alignment.
build_cand_panel.R calls load_month_factors(sd) for Factor DB access.
regime_state is inherited from STR_1715 alpha_scores, but this WT provides no dd_lag/vol_lag or t-1 overlay proof.
Inherited score_eff uses fundamental/analyst components, but no factor_engine_proposal.R or WT-local lag audit proves annual May / quarterly 45d timing.
No top-decile or selected-name 20d TV audit is provided against the 2e8 KRW base hard constraint.

critical_concerns.description: Lockbox contamination: the discovery and final validation use dates through 2026-04, while the base context seals Lockbox from 2024-01-23 and requires Pre-LB / Lockbox / Combined reporting. This makes the selected R05 regime blend a full-sample research decision, not a valid PIT discovery.

Multiple-testing deflation is undercounted. The package uses N=20 even though it tested 20 candidates, regime constraints, 324 blend grid combinations, buffered turnover variants, and five post-hoc specs; the five specs are not the required CAPM/Carhart/FF5/FF6 regression set.

Cost and turnover are silently redefined after failure. final_validation.rds reports annual one-way turnover 6.318 and cost 189.5 bps with pass_50bps=false; incremental_cost.R reframes the mandate as incremental vs baseline and the package advertises only 3.5 bps.

No Silent Override is not satisfied: no challenge_note.md exists, artifact_lineage has null hash for .cache/factor_db/factor_db_*.parquet, and the requested risk/optimization packages, weights.csv, canonical alpha_scores.parquet, and covariance.parquet are absent.

The crisis-hedge claim depends on only 3 CRISIS months and 18 stress months; Spec3 stress-only NW-t is 2.292 and fails the 3.023 threshold, yet the package downgrades it to LOW because the sample is small.

AX-005/AX-007 exclusions are asserted but not proven. The output remains a top-20 long-only single composite, MDD complement is explicitly DEFERRED, and no Gate13/portfolio-level MDD <45% evidence is supplied.

RF-A2 is unresolved: composite ICIR 1.436 is below C04_ESBR single factor ICIR 1.652 and C19_Composite_Earnings 1.477 in overall_ic.csv, so the incremental value of the new blend is stress-conditional and not dominant on full ICIR.

Academic mechanism evidence is too thin for Charter approval: references lack page-level citations, R05 construction is described only as a rolling realized tail-risk measure, and KR translation relies mainly on the same in-sample IC evidence under dispute.

supporting_arguments: alpha_scores_new.parquet is genuinely time-series: 268 monthly sig_dates from 2004-01-01 to 2026-04-01, not a single-snapshot RF-A7 repeat.
R05 standalone shows mean Spearman correlation 0.1717 vs score_eff and positive CAUTION/CRISIS IC in the provided artifacts.
C13/C14/C15 are partially supported by factor_db_connector.R using Z_Score_Aligned and Usable_Date <= sig_date.
unresolved_disputes: Whether any result survives Train-only selection through 2023-12 before opening the 2024-01-23+ Lockbox.
Whether true total search-space HLZ/DSR remains significant after including candidate, regime, grid, and buffer selection degrees of freedom.
Whether top-decile and selected top-20 names pass the base 20d TV >= 2e8 KRW liquidity constraint.
Whether regime_state used for w_new is strictly t-1 lagged under PIT-C9.

Whether portfolio-level weights satisfy max_names=20, bounds [0,0.20], sum(weights)=1, turnover <600%, cost, PSD covariance, and MDD <45%; required weights.csv and covariance.parquet were not present.
weakest_assumption: The most fragile claim is that the 0.80 CAUTION/CRISIS R05 blend is a valid KR crisis hedge even though it was selected on full-sample 2004-2026 data, has only 3 CRISIS months, fails stress-only NW-t, and lacks portfolio-level MDD proof.
rebuttal_required: Re-run candidate selection and blend tuning using Train-only data ending 2023-12, then report sealed Lockbox and Combined results separately.
Recompute Harvey/DSR using the full effective search count, including 20 candidates, 324 regime blend grid points, buffer variants, and any prior V5 exploration.
Provide the required challenge_note.md with RF-A1~A7, sector-neutral IC, monotonicity, top-decile liquidity, and no-silent-override disposition.
Provide canonical alpha_scores.parquet, weights.csv, covariance.parquet, and risk/optimization packages for AX-008 triangulation.
Remove Ret_1m from alpha emission artifacts or place labels in a separate validation-only artifact.
Prove PIT-C9 regime lag and PIT-C4 inherited fundamental lags with code-level evidence.
